series.name: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes
series.notes: Orion XS error codes are reported in the VictronConnect app or on a connected GX device - NOT as a front-panel LED blink count. Numbering is Victron's own DC-DC/charger error namespace, completely different from the VE.Bus numbers: e.g. Orion 'Error 1' is battery temperature, while VE.Bus 1 is a failed phase. NEVER cross-map the two. The older Orion-Tr Smart DC-DC uses the same numeric namespace (its manual points at the shared live error-code page for 'Error 2', '26', '27', '116', '119').

meaning.en: Charging has stopped to protect the battery. Auto-resets once the battery cools down.
meaning.ur: Battery bachane ke liye charging band kar di gayi hai. Battery thanda hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Battery genuinely above its permitted charging temperature
causes.ur: Battery haqeeqat mein apni charging temperature se upar hai

causes.en: Charger itself overheated at start-up or float, with no external sensor fitted - then the charger reads hot battery
causes.ur: Bahar ka sensor nahi laga to charger ke start-up ya float mein khud garam hua, phir use garam battery samajh aaya

solutions.en: Measure actual battery temperature with a probe thermometer at the cell terminals.
solutions.ur: Cell terminals par probe thermometer se asal battery temperature nikaalein.

solutions.en: Improve ventilation around the battery bank and the charger.
solutions.ur: Battery bank aur charger ke aar paas hawa ka raasta behtar karein.

solutions.en: If no external temperature sensor is fitted, note the error may be a false reading from a hot charger.
solutions.ur: Agar bahar ka temperature sensor nahi laga hai to yaad rakhein ke ye garam charger ka false reading bhi ho sakta hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: The target battery voltage is too high for the charger. Auto-resets when the voltage drops.
meaning.ur: Target battery voltage charger ke liye bohat zyada hai. Voltage girne par khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Other charging equipment connected to the same battery
causes.ur: Usi battery se koi aur charging equipment jury hai

causes.en: A fault in the charge controller
causes.ur: Charge controller mein koi fault

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage and compare to the battery type's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage nikaal kar battery type ki maximum charge voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect other chargers one at a time to find which one is overdriving the bank.
solutions.ur: Baqi chargers ek ek kar ke disconnect karein taake pata chale kaun bank ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the configured charge voltage in VictronConnect against the battery datasheet.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein set ki hui charge voltage ko battery datasheet se check karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

title.ur: Current kam karne par bhi controller garam ho gaya

meaning.en: The charger has already reduced its output and still overheated. Auto-resets when it cools.
meaning.ur: Charger ne output kam kar diya phir bhi garam ho gaya. Thanda hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high around the charger
causes.ur: Charger ke aar paas ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Charger not mounted for cooling - e.g. lying flat or boxed in
causes.ur: Charger cooling ke liye suitable mount nahi hai - maslan flat pada ya box mein band

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature where the charger is installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke charger jahan laga hai wahan ambient temperature kya hai.

solutions.en: Mount the charger vertically on a wall with clearance so air can flow past it.
solutions.ur: Charger ko deewar par vertical lagaayein aur hawa ke liye jagah chhodein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

title.ur: Current sensor range se bahar hai

meaning.en: Current measurement is out of range. Does NOT auto-reset; a power-cycle of the wiring is required.
meaning.ur: Current measurement range se bahar hai. Khud reset nahi hota; wiring ka power cycle karna parta hai.

causes.en: Wiring disturbed, e.g. during installation work
causes.ur: Wiring mein tabdeeli hui ho, maslan installation ke dauran

causes.en: Hardware defect in the current measurement circuit
causes.ur: Current measurement circuit mein hardware defect

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then disconnect ALL wires from the charger.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir charger se tamam wires disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect all wires to make the charger restart, then read the error again.
solutions.ur: Tamam wires dobara connect karein taake charger restart ho, phir error dobara parhein.

solutions.en: If the error remains, contact the dealer - there may be a hardware defect.
solutions.ur: Agar error qataar rahe to dealer se rabta karein - ho sakta hai hardware defect ho.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: The power terminals have overheated. Auto-resets once they cool.
meaning.ur: Power terminals garam ho gaye hain. Thande hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Loose terminal connection causing high contact resistance
causes.ur: Dheela terminal connection jis se contact resistance zyada hai

causes.en: Undersized or wrong-strand cable for the current
causes.ur: Current ke liye chhoti ya galat strand wali cable

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the wiring type and the number of strands in the cable.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir cable ki type aur strands ki tadaad check karein.

solutions.en: Re-tighten the power terminals to the torque stated in the manual, and re-check after an hour.
solutions.ur: Power terminals ko manual di gayi torque par tighten karein, aur aik ghante baad dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Fit a cable of adequate cross-section and correct strand type for the charge current.
solutions.ur: Charge current ke liye kaafi cross-section aur sahi strand type wali cable lagayein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

title.en: Charger short circuit on battery side
title.ur: Battery side par charger short circuit

meaning.en: An over-current condition on the battery side, often from a contactor or from connecting the charger to a large-capacitance inverter with no battery fitted. Auto-resets.
meaning.ur: Battery side par over-current ki shart, aksar contactor se ya badi capacitance wale inverter se bina battery ke connect karne se. Khud reset hota hai.

causes.en: Battery attached through a contactor that chatters or welds
causes.ur: Battery aik aise contactor se jury hai jo chatter karta ya weld ho jata hai

causes.en: Charger started with no battery but connected to a large input-capacitance inverter
causes.ur: Charger bina battery ke chala aur badi input capacitance wale inverter se jury tha

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the battery cable and contactor for a short.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir battery cable aur contactor mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources, wait 3 minutes, then power up again.
solutions.ur: Tamam power sources disconnect karein, 3 minute intezaar karein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: If the error does not auto-reset after that, the charge controller is probably faulty.
solutions.ur: Uske baad bhi error khud resolve na ho to charge controller kharab hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: A fault in the charger's switching power stage. Does NOT auto-reset.
meaning.ur: Charger ke switching power stage mein fault. Khud reset nahi hota.

causes.en: Internal switching stage failure
causes.ur: Internal switching stage ki failure

causes.en: Disturbed or transient wiring during operation
causes.ur: Operation ke dauran wiring mein tabdeeli ya transient masla

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then disconnect all wires from the charger.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir charger se tamam wires disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect all wires and power up; re-read the error.
solutions.ur: Tamam wires dobara connect kar ke on karein; error dobara parhein.

solutions.en: If it persists the charger is probably faulty - return to the dealer.
solutions.ur: Agar qataar rahe to charger kharab hai - dealer ko wapas karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: The input voltage is above the charger's limit. Auto-resets once the input drops to a safe level.
meaning.ur: Input voltage charger ki limit se upar hai. Input safe level par aane par khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Starter/alternator charging voltage too high for the charger input
causes.ur: Starter/alternator ki charging voltage charger ke input se zyada hai

causes.en: Two chargers' outputs connected together in parallel
causes.ur: Do chargers ke output aapas mein parallel jury ho gaye hain

solutions.en: Measure the input voltage at the charger's input terminals with the engine running.
solutions.ur: Engine chalate hue charger ke input terminals par input voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare to the Orion XS input voltage range in the manual's specification table.
solutions.ur: Manual ki specification table mein diye Orion XS input voltage range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check that no second charger output is hard-wired in parallel.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke doosre charger ka output saath hard-wire to nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

title.ur: BMS ka connection nahi mil raha

meaning.en: The charger is set to be BMS-controlled but receives no BMS control messages. After 15 s it drops output to base voltage (12 V); the error itself only shows after 3 min so the BMS can reconnect quietly.
meaning.ur: Charger BMS control ke liye set hai magar koi BMS control message nahi mil raha. 15 second baad output base voltage (12 V) par gir jata hai; khud error 3 minute baad dikhta hai taake BMS dobara connect ho sake.

causes.en: BMS powered down or in a protective shutdown
causes.ur: BMS band hai ya protective shutdown mein hai

causes.en: BMS CAN or communication cable disconnected or faulty
causes.ur: BMS ka CAN ya communication cable disconnect ya kharab

causes.en: Charger configured as BMS-controlled but no BMS is actually installed
causes.ur: Charger BMS-controlled set hai magar asal mein koi BMS install hi nahi

solutions.en: Check the BMS status on the VictronConnect device list - is it powered and talking?
solutions.ur: VictronConnect ki device list mein BMS ka status dekhein - woh on hai aur baat kar raha hai?

solutions.en: Inspect the BMS communication cable and both connectors; reseat them.
solutions.ur: BMS communication cable aur dono connectors dekhein; dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: If there is genuinely no BMS, change the charge mode to Standalone instead of BMS-controlled.
solutions.ur: Agar wakai koi BMS nahi hai to charge mode ko BMS-controlled ke bajaye Standalone par kar dein.

notes.en: In VictronConnect this appears as the charger jumping straight from bulk to float. Once communication returns it goes back to bulk on its own.
notes.ur: VictronConnect mein ye charger ka seedha bulk se float par jaana dikhta hai. Communication wapas aane par ye khud bulk par wapas chala jata hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: If this is the ACTIVE error the unit is faulty and must be replaced. If it only appears in history data while the unit works normally, it is safe to ignore - factory-fresh units legitimately log it once.
meaning.ur: Agar ye ACTIVE error hai to unit kharab hai aur badalna parta hai. Agar sirf history data mein aaye aur unit theek chalta hai to ignore kiya ja sakta hai - factory naye units aik baar ye log karte hain.

causes.en: Active error: unit calibration data is gone, hardware fault
causes.ur: Active error: unit ka calibration data kho gaya, hardware fault

causes.en: History only: never cleared after first factory power-up
causes.ur: Sirf history mein: factory pehli power-up ke baad kabhi clear nahi hua

solutions.en: Check whether 116 is the ACTIVE error or only sits in the history log.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke 116 ACTIVE error hai ya sirf history log mein hai.

solutions.en: If ACTIVE: contact the dealer for a replacement unit.
solutions.ur: Agar ACTIVE hai to dealer se replacement unit ke liye rabta karein.

solutions.en: If history only and the unit operates normally, no action needed - do not replace the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf history mein hai aur unit normal chalta hai to koi karam nahi - unit mat badlein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: A firmware update did not complete, so the device is only partially updated. Retrying the update normally fixes it.
meaning.ur: Firmware update adhoora reh gaya, is liye device aadha updated hai. Update dobara chalane se aam tor par hal ho jata hai.

causes.en: Device went out of range during an over-the-air update
causes.ur: Over-the-air update ke dauran device range se bahar chala gaya

causes.en: Cable disconnected or power lost during the update session
causes.ur: Update session ke dauran cable disconnect hui ya power chala gaya

solutions.en: Retry the firmware update from VictronConnect using the firmware file.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect se firmware file le kar update dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: If a GX device is connected to VRM, do a remote firmware update from the VRM website.
solutions.ur: Agar GX device VRM se jury hai to VRM website se remote firmware update karein.

solutions.en: Keep the charger powered and the Bluetooth link stable for the whole update.
solutions.ur: Poori update ke dauran charger ko power aur Bluetooth link mustaqbil rakhein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

title.ur: Settings data kho gaya ya parha nahi ja raha

meaning.en: The charger cannot read its configuration and has stopped. Does NOT auto-reset; the documented recovery is a factory reset plus a 3-minute power-off wait.
meaning.ur: Charger apni configuration nahi parh sakta aur ruk gaya hai. Khud reset nahi hota; bataya hua hal factory reset aur 3 minute power off ke intezaar se hai.

causes.en: Configuration memory corrupted, often after an interrupted update
causes.ur: Configuration memory corrupt, aksar interrupted update ke baad

causes.en: Power lost while settings were being written
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt power chala gaya

solutions.en: Restore factory defaults from the three-dot menu at the top right in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect ke top right teen-dot menu se factory defaults restore karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the charge controller from all power sources.
solutions.ur: Charge controller ko tamam power sources se disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Wait 3 minutes, then power up again and reconfigure the charger.
solutions.ur: 3 minute intezaar karein, phir wapas on karke charger dobara configure karein.

solutions.en: Report it to the Victron dealer for escalation - Victron state this should never happen.
solutions.ur: Isay Victron dealer ko report karein - Victron ke mutabiq ye hona hi nahi chahiye.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: The unit's own internal diagnostics found a fault with an internal supply voltage. Does NOT auto-reset.
meaning.ur: Unit ke apne internal diagnostics ne internal supply voltage mein fault dhoondha. Khud reset nahi hota.

causes.en: Internal supply rail outside its expected window
causes.ur: Internal supply rail apni expected window se bahar

causes.en: Faulty internal supply stage
causes.ur: Internal supply stage kharab

solutions.en: Check the installation - cable sizes, terminations and battery connections.
solutions.ur: Installation check karein - cable sizes, terminations aur battery connections.

solutions.en: Restart the unit using the power switch.
solutions.ur: Unit ko power switch se restart karein.

solutions.en: If the error persists, the unit is probably faulty - return to the dealer.
solutions.ur: Agar error qataar rahe to unit kharab hai - dealer ko wapas karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

meaning.en: Stored history data is corrupt. Does NOT auto-reset; cleared by clearing history in VictronConnect.
meaning.ur: Store ki hui history data corrupt hai. Khud reset nahi hota; VictronConnect mein history clear karne se saaf hota hai.

causes.en: History memory corrupted after a power cut during logging
causes.ur: Logging ke dauran power cut ke baad history memory corrupt hua

causes.en: Firmware or storage fault on the unit
causes.ur: Unit par firmware ya storage fault

solutions.en: Open the History screen in VictronConnect for the charger.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein charger ka History screen kholein.

solutions.en: Clear the history data to reset the error.
solutions.ur: Error reset karne ke liye history data clear karein.

solutions.en: Only after clearing, check the charger is charging correctly.
solutions.ur: Clear karne ke baad hi check karein ke charger theek charge kar raha hai.
